title: introduce-adaptive-token-surge-dampener-and-span-recon-panel
author: Ava Martinez
release_notes:
- Add adaptive token-surge dampener to reduce alert noise during request bursts
- Add span-reconciliation engine to stitch late-arriving spans to invocations
- New Cost Projection panel with per-model cold-start attribution and projected 7-day spend
- Alert fusion rules to coalesce redundant token-level SLO alerts
body:
Context and motivation:
We frequently see token-level alert storms when upstream clients send short bursts of high-concurrency requests. These surges produce noisy SLO alerts (p50/p95 oscillation) and generate many redundant PagerDuty incidents. Additionally, late-arriving tracing spans (collector batching / network jitter) were creating disconnected traces which made root-cause diffs harder for oncall. This PR introduces a two-part observability solution: 1) an adaptive token-surge dampener that gates alerting sensitivity during transient bursts, and 2) a span-reconciliation engine that joins late spans back to their original invocation and emits reconciliation metrics for debugging.

What changed (high level):
- telemetry/surge_dampener: new service implementing exponential decay windowing + adaptive hysteresis to suppress transient token SLO alerts and emit dampening metrics (dampener.active, dampener.suppressed_alerts, dampener.reason).
- telemetry/span_reconciler: stream processor that listens to span ingestion, matches late spans to invocation anchors, and emits reconciliation events and span.delta_ms histograms.
- grafana/dashboards/cost_projection.json: new panel showing real-time per-model cold-start attribution, predicted 7-day token spend, and sparkline of projected trend.
- alerts/token_slo_fusion.rules: introduce fusion rules that collapse per-route token SLO alerts when dampener.active is true, plus an emergency bypass if sustained error rate > 1%.
- sdk-metrics: minor helper added to annotations to tag reconciled spans with reconciliation_id and original_invocation_id.

Checklist:
- [x] Implementation + unit tests for dampener and reconciler
- [x] Integration test for span reattachment with delayed ingestion
- [x] Dashboard panel + panel tests (snapshots)
- [x] Alert rule e2e smoke test on staging
- [x] Docs + runbook update (observability/runbooks/token-surge-dampener.md)

Commits (summary):
- 1a2b3c4: add adaptive dampener service and basic API
- 2b3c4d5: add reconciliation engine and matching heuristics
- 3c4d5e6: grafana panel + queries for projection and cold-start attribution
- 4d5e6f7: alert fusion rules and unit tests
- 5e6f7g8: docs + runbook + integration tests

Illustrative snippet (dampener config example):
"""yaml
dampener:
  window_ms: 120000
  initial_sensitivity: 0.7
  decay_alpha: 0.3
  bypass_error_threshold_pct: 1.0
"""

- telemetry/surge_dampener/main.go
- telemetry/surge_dampener/config.go
- telemetry/span_reconciler/processor.go
- telemetry/span_reconciler/matcher_test.go
- grafana/dashboards/cost_projection.json
- alerts/token_slo_fusion.rules

- docs/observability/token-surge-dampener.md

Review conversation summary:
- Jordan: requested clearer semantics for dampener.active vs suppressed_alerts and an observability-only metric for debugging. I added dampener.debug_window_count and clarified docs.
- Priya: asked for performance guardrails on the reconciler matching algorithm to avoid O(n^2). Implemented a bounded lookback with hashed anchors and added benchmark results to PR.
- Ethan: raised concern about alert fusion hiding real incidents. Added bypass rule when sustained errors exceed bypass_error_threshold_pct and a short-term broadcast to the #oncall channel when fusion suppresses > 5 alerts in a minute.
- Follow-ups: created ENG-8977 to evaluate long-term ML-based anomaly detection if dampening is insufficient.

CI and stability:
- Unit tests: pass (coverage added for matcher edge cases)
- Integration tests: staging run green (span reconnection scenario, alert fusion smoke)
- Load benchmarks: reconciler throughput ~12k spans/s for the configured instance type (p95 within budget).

Rollout plan and migration notes:
1) Deploy dampener and reconciler to staging and enable dampening in passive mode (emit metric but do not suppress alerts) for 48h.
2) Flip into active mode for a single SLO group for 72h and monitor dampener.suppressed_alerts / oncall feedback.
3) Gradually enable fusion rules for additional SLO groups by traffic tier.
4) If reconciliation produces >0.05% mismatches, rollback the reconciler and investigate via span_reconciler/replay tool.

Merge details:
- Merge method: squash and merge
- Post-merge: created a follow-up PR to add per-tenant feature flag gating for Private deployments (feature flag + docs).

If anything regresses in next 24h, oncall should follow the runbook at observability/runbooks/token-surge-dampener.md which includes quick disable and metric slices to inspect.

References:
- ENG-8723: token surge incident follow-up
- SUP-4482: customer report of disconnected spans
